branches.select_when: No exercised candidate provides a bounded credible path, or any zero-tolerance isolation, identity, reset, cleanup, immutable-input, or orphan gate fails.
Trusted native execution is credible at concurrency one but the highest clean tested concurrency is below two.

The native candidate passes every correctness and recovery gate, warm workspace p95 is strictly below 3 seconds, simulator ready p95 is strictly below 15 seconds, and clean concurrency reaches at least two.
